title: ID0410798-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001481] Charging session interrupted
description:

Charging power at the left charging point is always interrupted after a certain time and charging is not continued. Colleague charged from 11-15% and then charging was interrupted
Root cause:
session was stopped due to Cable
temperature sensor error
Solution:
Query answered, No response from customer.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: Active

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0410798-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001481] Charging session interrupted CRM:00921001607
additional_info.body:
Dear Berent Yul,
I hope this message finds you well.
Thank you for your patience while we investigated the reported issue. After a thorough review of the logs, we identified that the session was terminated due to a cable temperature error that occurred during the charging process. This error self-resolved within 20-30 seconds, allowing the connector to become available again.
Additionally, we have analyzed the cable temperature error logs over the past four weeks and found that this issue occurred only on March 4th.
Since that occurrence, the charger has been functioning as expected, with successful charging sessions reported.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or if we can proceed with closing this ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0410798-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001481] Charging session interrupted CRM:00921001607
additional_info.body:
Dear Berent Yul,
The issue is not cable overheating, but rather the temperature difference between the DC+ and DC- cables.
This difference may be caused by factors such as ambient temperature, a loose connection on the charger side, or poor contact between the CCS2 plug and the vehicle socket.
The temperature difference of 16°C led to the session being interrupted.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: AW: ID0410798-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001481] Charging session interrupted CRM:00921001607
additional_info.body:
Dear Berent Yul,
There are multiple root causes for the cable temperature error:
Dirt on CCS pins
Water ingress in the CCS plug, leading to incorrect CP reading (hardware issue)
Corrosion of connector blades
We can inspect whether the CCS pins are clean or dirty. If they are dirty, we can clean the CCS pins to prevent such errors.
Hope this answers your query. Can we proceed with closing the ticket?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
